backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing a social media marketing service platform with user profiles, services (followers/likes/views across platforms), cart/order management, testimonials, and role-based access control using MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the removal of an image element from the Hero component at a specific XPath, with high confidence and associated test ID REQ-1.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including App routing, query hooks, cart management, pages (Hero, Services, Admin), and Arabic RTL UI with WhatsApp integration and user profile management.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements (background, foreground, primary, secondary, borders, charts, sidebar) using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Arabic RTL configuration, Inter font preload, favicon reference, and meta tags for the SMM Ourprice social media marketing services application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup defining routes (home, services, admin), Layout wrapper with Header/Footer/ProfileSetupDialog, ThemeProvider, CartProvider, and AdminAuthGate for protected routes.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: Authentication and authorization guard for admin routes. Checks Internet Identity login status and admin privileges, displaying appropriate prompts for login or access denied states.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashb: Main admin dashboard with tabbed interface for overview, services, orders, and testimonials management. Displays welcome message with user profile name and navigation tabs with icons.
frontend/src/components/admin/DashboardO: Admin dashboard overview showing key metrics cards (total orders, pending orders, total revenue) and recent activity list. Calculates statistics from orders data with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrdersTabl: Admin component that displays all customer orders in a table with status badges, contact info, and allows updating order status (pending/completed/cancelled) via a dropdown select.
frontend/src/components/admin/ServiceMan: Admin component for managing social media services with functionality to add new services, toggle availability, and update pricing for different platforms (Facebook, Instagram, etc.) and service types (followers, likes, views).
frontend/src/components/admin/Testimonia: Admin component that displays customer testimonials in a table and provides a dialog form to add new testimonials with customer name, service type, rating (1-5 stars), and testimonial text.
frontend/src/components/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart sidebar component (content truncated in source).
frontend/src/components/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page component (content truncated in source).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Arabic RTL footer with IBAZEX logo, quick links navigation, social media icons (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), contact details, copyright notice, and Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with IBAZEX logo and Arabic navigation links (home, services, admin) using TanStack Router Link components with active state styling and RTL layout.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with background image overlay, IBAZEX gradient text logo, Arabic tagline, WhatsApp contact indicator, three feature cards (followers/likes/views), CTA button navigating to services, and integrated Testimonials component.
frontend/src/components/OrderSuccess.tsx: Order success confirmation page component (content truncated in source).
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: A modal dialog component that prompts users to enter their full name to complete profile setup. Uses a mutation hook to save the profile and displays loading/error states with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Displays a social media service card with platform icons, pricing calculator, and order dialog. Handles quantity input validation and generates WhatsApp URLs for order submission with user-provided account/post links.
frontend/src/components/ServicesPage.tsx: Main services listing page with platform filter tabs (all, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok). Fetches available services and renders them as a grid of ServiceCard components with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Displays customer testimonials in a grid layout with star ratings, service type badges, and customer names. Fetches testimonials via query hook and shows loading skeletons or hides section if empty.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCart.tsx: React context provider and hook for managing shopping cart state, including adding/removing items, updating quantities, calculating totals, and tracking item counts for social media services.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options for idle handling and derivation origins.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating services, orders, and testimonials data through the actor interface, including operations like adding/updating services, placing orders, and managing testimonials.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, RTL text direction, Arabic font setup, and custom animation utilities (fadeIn, slideIn, zoomIn).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and session storage, supporting both regular query strings and hash-based routing with persistence.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp URLs with pre-filled Arabic messages containing service order details including platform, service type, quantity, price, and customer account information.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes, container settings, border radius variables, font families, shadows, and accordion animations with RTL support.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking one existing feature request to remove a hero section image element from the homepage component.
